items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron, saying
items.claim: The LORD commanded Moses and Aaron regarding leprosy identification

items.quote: When a man shall have in the skin of his flesh a rising, a scab, or bright spot, and it be in the skin of his flesh like the plague of leprosy; then he shall be brought unto Aaron the priest, or unto one of his sons the priests
items.claim: A man with skin symptoms resembling leprosy shall be brought to Aaron the priest or one of his sons
items.object: Aaron the priest, or one of his sons the priests

items.quote: And the priest shall look on the plague in the skin of the flesh: and when the hair in the plague is turned white, and the plague in sight be deeper than the skin of his flesh, it is a plague of leprosy: and the priest shall look on him, and pronounce him unclean
items.claim: The priest diagnoses leprosy when white hair appears in the lesion and it extends deeper than the skin, then pronounces the person unclean
items.mechanism: white hair in plague; plague deeper than skin
